{{Top|leg}}
A '''supercharger''' allowed vehicles to increase their normal speed for a limited duration. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[WLZ-101 Groundcoach]] included a supercharger that allowed it to increase its maximum speed from two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to three hundred and thirty. The supercharger had to cool for ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before being used again.
